raw_segments.text: Most true is it that beauty is in the eye of the gazer. My master's colorless, olive
face, square, massive brow, broad and jettie eyebrows, deep eyes, strong features, firm
grim mouth—all energy, decision, will—were not beautiful, according to rule. But they
were more than beautiful to me. They were full of an interest, an influence that quite
mastered me. That took my feelings from my own power and fettered them in his.
I had not intended to love him. The reader knows I had wrought hard to extirpate from
my soul the germs of love there detected. And now, at the first renewed view of him,
they spontaneously arrived, green and strong. He made me love him without looking at me.
